updated_note: Public-source organizational relationships, not a single statutory chain of command. Only ownership nodes have equity relations; policy oversight and commercial partnerships are different edge types. The subsidiary/member list denotes MIND ID six principal members; non-wholly-owned Vale/Freeport equity is explicitly marked. Other affiliates are selected documented examples rather than an exhaustive sub-subsidiary roster.

notes: Hierarchy is an analytical flow: President → ministry → directorate and President → Danantara → state portfolio companies. DPR/BPK and BRIN are independent functional counterparts.
Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia (DSI) is a sibling export-governance arm in Danantara ecosystem, not MIND ID's parent.
PT Vale's MIND ID 34% interest is not complete control. Share figures source dated and not auto-updated to current securities register.
Only six principal MIND ID member companies are listed; all indirect subsidiaries of each are not enumerated, pending verified corporate registers.
